player_prompt.intro:
Ove uli {role} mu Colonel Blotto.
O lukongo lwetu ni kuvinga vilonda vingi kuliko kambundi.
Pa kila vilonda, weka vikosi {num_total_units} mu malonda {field_names}.
O kambundi weka vikosi vingi mu malonda, ove uli ovinga malonda, na o kambundi ovinga malonda vingi, ove uli ovinga vilonda.
Kwa mfano, '[A7 B7 C6]' weka vikosi 7 mu A, 7 mu B, na 6 mu C.
player_prompt.commander_beta: Komanda Beta, o kasi oku ku kuatisa.
